bugs.title: Division by zero where $Z = 0$
bugs.runs: The line ran in all seven runs with settling, but Z was never below 0.0020; it needs `LDIFZ` and a model with Z = 0 somewhere.

bugs.title: The first midpoint can be interpolated from the wrong model points
bugs.runs: The search ran in all seven runs with settling, such as `testsuite/Test_solarGS98_dif`, and never failed; it needs a first point beyond `NPT`, as for a large convective core under few points.

bugs.title: The grid is coarser than the comment says
bugs.runs: In the rotating solar model with settling, DR exceeded DRMIN at all 3,702 grid setups (by up to 1.020); the fix's effect stays within the null change (log L 0.00021 against 0.00029 dex).

bugs.title: With NITER_GS = 0, the implicit term is skipped and the warning prints old values
bugs.runs: The loop ran in all seven runs with settling, such as `testsuite/Test_solarGS98_dif`, always with `NITER_GS` = 10; every case sets 10, and it needs `NITER_GS` = 0.

bugs.title: The convergence test is one-sided
bugs.runs: The loop ended one iteration early 14 to 259 times per run; with the fix, `testsuite/Test_m1p4feh+0p0GS98_dif_TAMS` and `testsuite/Test_solarM22M_difkur` give identical tracks and stored models.

bugs.title: The midpoint change is shifted by one point
bugs.runs: `EQCOD2X_H` is set to zero just before every use, and it was zero every time in all seven runs with settling.

bugs.title: No check that IEND > IBEGIN
bugs.runs: `MIX` and `ROTMIX` switch settling off once central X falls below `XMIN`, so the searches give `IEND` at least `IBEGIN` + 2; only Y below `YMIN` outside the core could move `IEND` lower.

bugs.title: The sentinel LCZ(M+1) is written past the model
bugs.runs: In the 33 runs that got past their start, models had 349 to 3,455 shells, never 5,000, so the sentinel never fell outside the array; it needs a model of 5,000 shells.

bugs.title: Helium is not recomputed after the clean-up
bugs.runs: Never occurred: in 12,145 calls over five cases neither clamp acted; the fix, which also resets Y everywhere, changes results by about the size of the null change (log L 0.071 against 0.057 dex in the 1.4 M☉ case).

bugs.title: The first midpoint's search runs over the wrong indices
bugs.runs: These are the old settling routines, which no case uses; reaching them takes `LDIFY` or `LDIFZ` with `LNEWDIF` false and `LDIFLI` off, and a model whose `IBEGIN` exceeds `NPT`.

bugs.title: WNEW overwrites the namelist's solid-body rate
bugs.runs: The overwrite happened at every step in `testsuite/Test_m0p8feh+0p0GS98_rotp8p0d0p1mag1e4std_TAMS`, but no later run read `WNEW`; a later run with `LFIRST(k)` true, k > 1, `LROT`, `LWNEW`, and `LMWIND` would.

bugs.title: Metals other than C and O are left out
bugs.runs: In the 1 M☉ run to helium ignition the fractions summed to 0.984 to 0.991 in 33,460,185 calls; the fix changes the last neutrino luminosity from 0.845 to 0.876 L☉ (null change: 0.846), with log L within the noise and central log T a little beyond it.

bugs.title: Table 9 at $Z = 0.04$
bugs.runs: The high-X branch ran 350 times in `testsuite/Test_m1p4feh+0p0GS98_dif_TAMS`, at a table Z of 0.0188, never at Z = 0.04; `ZOPAL951` = 0.04 with a surface X above 0.8 would reach it.

bugs.title: The last $X$ node taken as 1 instead of $1 - Z$
bugs.runs: In `testsuite/Test_m1p4feh+0p0GS98_dif_TAMS`, the misplaced node was in the stencil 203 times; with the fix, the track and the `.store` file are identical.

bugs.title: The run stops for $0.08 < Z \le 0.1$
bugs.runs: No case sets `ZOPAL951` above 0.08; `ZOPAL951` between 0.08 and 0.1 would reach it.

bugs.title: Label 30 in the wrong place
bugs.runs: Any Z above 0.08, and so Z of 0.1 or more, stops the run before label 30, since the search for the four Z values runs only to `NUMZ-1` (bug 1).

bugs.title: MEVAL's error code is ignored
bugs.runs: In all 33 runs that got past their start, MEVAL never returned `ERR` = 2; points out of order would reach it, and no caller gave them.

bugs.title: The wrong message for a rescale-and-evolve card
bugs.runs: In `examples/run_from_seed_to_start/m10000gs98z001000_prems`, the wrong message was printed once; with format 551 restored, the track and `.store` file are identical, and only the `.short` file changes.

bugs.title: ISETMIX = 2 and ISETISO = 2 do nothing
bugs.runs: A made-up case: `testsuite/Test_solarAAG21_dif` with `ISETMIX` = `ISETISO` = 2 and its custom mixture on; the fix moves log L by up to 0.0025 dex on the pre-main sequence, against 0.00023 for the null change.

bugs.title: ZENV set from every run card
bugs.runs: The line set `ZENV` = 0 in 32 runs; with it dropped, `testsuite/Test_m0p3feh+0p0GS98_scv_ZAMS` and `examples/run_standard_solar_model/Test_solarcal_noGS_norot` give identical tracks and `.store` files.

bugs.title: No / in FTRACK leaves LAST_SLASH_IDX unset
bugs.runs: Every `FTRACK` in the 33 runs named a folder; four namelists in `sample_cases/Gyrochrones`, such as `rotevolin_m0p2per1p4`, name none and were not run.

bugs.title: EXPAND_VALUE leaves the end of TEMP undefined
bugs.runs: Every run set all three variables; the withdrawal rests on gfortran's behavior, and a compiler that leaves the argument unchanged for an unset variable would bring the item back.

bugs.title: Long paths are cut to 256 characters without a word
bugs.runs: Checked by reading the code: a 201-character output folder cuts a case's names to 256 characters without a message; in the round of Nov 9, two fix runs lost their files this way.

bugs.title: Two different lines under the same labels
bugs.runs: PDIST runs only with `LPOUT` on, which no case sets; any run with `LPOUT` on reaches this line at every model.

bugs.title: IEND undefined
bugs.runs: PINDEX's only caller, PUTSTORE, passes its own `LSHELL`, which nothing sets (PUTSTORE's bug 3); it was false at every call.

bugs.title: M listed twice
bugs.runs: PINDEX's only caller, PUTSTORE, passes its own `LSHELL`, which nothing sets (PUTSTORE's bug 3); it was false at every call.

bugs.title: The caller's luminosities are left in erg s⁻¹
bugs.runs: Luminosities in erg/s reached HTIMER and the `ISNU` fractions in 27 runs; with the fix, `testsuite/Test_m0p95feh+0p0_GN93_TAHB` gives an identical track, and only its `.short` file differs.

bugs.title: The SCV + OPAL 2006 label is lost
bugs.runs: The `LSCV` branch ran in 30 runs, but YREC's cases with SCV and OPAL 2006 all set `LDH`; any of them with `LDH` off would reach it.

bugs.title: Atmosphere 5 has no label
bugs.runs: A made-up case: `testsuite/Test_solarGS98_kurucz` with `KTTAU` = 5 and the Castelli-Kurucz table writes `ATM` without its own value at both stores; with the fix, the track is identical.

bugs.title: PINDEX gets arguments that are never set
bugs.runs: In 10 runs the shell's flag was set at a store, but no shell went unlisted: every old-format case keeps NPRTPT = 1, which lists every shell; the fix's .store change comes from PINDEX's own bug 2 (M listed twice), which the fix reaches.

bugs.title: The old header calls the triple-α column "3HE."
bugs.runs: The header was written in 14 runs; with the fix, `examples/run_from_dbl_to_zams/Test_m0040_feh0_noGS_ZAMS` gives an identical track and a `.store` file within 2%, as expected for a label.

bugs.title: The flags record does not match its reader
bugs.runs: Nothing in `src/` calls PUTYREC7.

bugs.title: The distortion factor in $d\log r/d\log P$
bugs.runs: In `testsuite/Test_m0p8feh+0p0GS98_rotp8p0d0p1mag1e4std_TAMS`, the fix moves log Teff by up to 0.000105, against 0.0000272 for the null change, while log L stays at the noise: not clearly above it.

bugs.title: A check that does not stop
bugs.runs: The check ran 128 times in each of the 33 runs and found no mismatch in `alexmol06gs98.tab`; a table file in another order or with other compositions would reach it.

bugs.title: No STATUS='OLD'
bugs.runs: The `OPEN` ran once in each of the 33 runs, and the file always existed; a wrong `FALEX06` would reach it.

bugs.title: The 2006 tables called "OEOS96" in a message
bugs.runs: In the 31 runs with the OPAL 2006 tables, every density row was long enough; only a damaged or different file reaches the message, and the run then stops.

bugs.title: ALOGNE read into one element
bugs.runs: Each of the 31 runs with the OPAL 2006 tables put 116,595 of 117,440 rows in the wrong element, but `ALOGNE` is read nowhere, so no output can change; the fix was not run.

bugs.title: The outer point for the settling step is not moved down
bugs.runs: In `testsuite/Test_m0p8feh+0p0GS98_rotp8p0d0p1mag1e4std_TAMS` and `testsuite/Test_solarGS98_difrotmixper18p4d1p0`, `J` always equaled `JMAX`; it matters only where Y at the top of the last radiative zone has fallen to `YMIN`.

bugs.title: The stop message names the wrong routine
bugs.runs: No run stopped here; a rotating run with `LDIFY` for a star without a surface convection zone would reach it, and stop.

bugs.title: The error message for one species names no species
bugs.runs: Every YREC case that sets `LNEWCP` has a target of 1.5D-5; a rescale card on a model with central hydrogen, with `LNEWCP` on and a target of 1 or more, would reach it.

bugs.title: The "new method" does not check the new total mass against the core
bugs.runs: The new method was not taken, the horizontal-branch cases included; a horizontal-branch rescale card with less than 0.01 M☉ outside the core and a target mass at or below the core's would reach it.

bugs.title: A merger keeps the upper zone's top
bugs.runs: In `sample_cases/UpperMS/Sample_m9p0feh+0p0GS98_yaleeos_sc_TAMS`, the one run with semiconvection, no two zones merged; it needs `LSEMIC` and a second zone within the walk's reach.

bugs.title: The radius is not updated in the walk
bugs.runs: In `sample_cases/UpperMS/Sample_m9p0feh+0p0GS98_yaleeos_sc_TAMS`, the walk used a wrong radius once; with the fix, the track and `.store` file are identical.

bugs.title: The new stop criteria are not copied to the repeated runs
bugs.runs: Never occurred: SETCAL ran once, in YREC's one calibration case, with no END_DCEN, END_XCEN, or END_YCEN set for run 2 or 3, so copying them changes nothing; the fix was not run.

bugs.title: QSMIXT reads the entropy of mixing beyond the lower row's pressures
bugs.runs: In all 32 runs with `LSCV`, 46 of 3,720 table points read an unset entry, but no counted stencil read one; with the fix, `testsuite/Test_m0p3feh+0p0GS98_scv_ZAMS` gives identical `.track` and `.store` files.

bugs.title: The same reads in QDTT and QAT, where a fix is undone
bugs.runs: In all 32 runs with `LSCV`, 46 of 3,720 points read unset entries; with the fix, `testsuite/Test_m0p3feh+0p0GS98_scv_ZAMS` gives identical files, since the two columns are read nowhere.

bugs.title: The derivatives miss the mixing factors
bugs.runs: These are the old settling routines, which no case uses; reaching them takes `LDIFY` or `LDIFZ` with `LNEWDIF` false, `LDIFLI` off, `LTHOUL`, and `CSTMIXING` or `CSTDIFFMIX` other than 1.

bugs.title: A wrong bound for the Kurucz/Castelli tables
bugs.runs: A made-up case: `testsuite/Test_solarGS98_kurucz` with `KTTAU` = 5 and the Castelli-Kurucz table; all 76 temperatures had a valid pressure, so the line never assigned `NG`.

bugs.title: The first shell's $\eta_2$ is seven times too large
bugs.runs: In `testsuite/Test_3Msolar_GS_rot_gray_OPALSCV_SF2_GS98_OP_CF10_RGp2diffrotI3cz2`, the fix moves log L by up to 0.0012 dex, against 0.0076 for the null change; the faster 2 M☉ cases were not run with it.

bugs.title: The Newton test for $r_0$ compares with ACFPFT, not its cube root
bugs.runs: In `testsuite/Test_m2p0_feh+0p0_vzams150_IES1_TAMS`, 15,909 solves ran all 20 steps; with the fix, every track difference is at most 1.6e-8, against 1.1e-7 for the null change.

bugs.title: The error message goes to unit 5
bugs.runs: In the 30 runs with the pivot test, the largest pivot was never below 0.229, so the matrix was never singular; a singular system would reach it.

bugs.title: A typo in tfac2
bugs.runs: In `testsuite/Test_m2p0_feh+0p0_vzams150_IES2_TAMS`, the fix moves log L by up to 7.95e-5 dex, against 1.58e-8 for the null change, with the same 546 models and end age.

bugs.title: A zone without angular momentum divides by zero
bugs.runs: In all five rotating cases the zone's angular momentum was never zero; an initial rotation of zero (`LWNEW` with `WNEW` = 0), or a start model without rotation, would reach it.

bugs.title: QIW in the Newton step
bugs.runs: In `testsuite/Test_m0p8feh+0p0GS98_rotp8p0d0p1mag1e4std_TAMS`, the fix moves log L by up to 0.00017 dex, against 0.00014 for the null change; in `testsuite/Test_m2p0_feh+0p0_vzams150_IES1_TAMS`, every difference equals the null change's.

bugs.title: The densities are not shifted in the core extension
bugs.runs: Wrong starting densities in 12 runs; with the fix, `testsuite/Test_solarGS98_allard` moves log L by up to 1.1e-4 dex, against 1.4e-4 for the null change, with the same models and end ages.

bugs.title: A reversed sign in the envelope interpolation
bugs.runs: No run, such as `examples/run_from_dbl_to_zams/Test_m0040_feh0_noGS_ZAMS`, placed the new point in the first envelope interval; a shallower fitting point there, with a last shell whose X or Z differs from the envelope's, would.

bugs.title: The defaults of R16_18 and R16_17 look swapped
bugs.runs: With 471.4 in place of 2693, `testsuite/Test_solarAAG21_dif` moves log L by up to 2.2e-5 dex, against 7.6e-5 for the null change; the starting oxygen-18 itself, the harm named, is not on the track.

bugs.title: 0/0 with one core point
bugs.runs: A made-up case: `testsuite/Test_solarGS98_kurucz` with `FCORE` = 1.0 stops in its first second in TPGRAD, at `STOP 912`; with the fix, it runs to its end.

bugs.title: The warning prints an unset variable
bugs.runs: In `examples/class_exercises/exercise_4/Grid_m4p0feh+0p0GS98_std25_TAMS`, a mixing length of 1.853 against the run's 1.708 printed no warning; with the test fixed it prints, and only the `.short` file differs.

bugs.title: The integration steps are not restored
bugs.runs: In `testsuite/Test_m0p1feh+0p0GS98_spot25_ZAMS`, the fix moves log L by up to 5.8e-5 dex, against 9.4e-9 for the null change, and the last model is at 16.677 Gyr instead of 16.714.

bugs.title: β of the interior is read from the envelope's array
bugs.runs: In 17 runs the interior's written beta came from the envelope's array; with the fix, `testsuite/Test_m0p3feh+0p0GS98_scv_ZAMS` and `testsuite/Test_solarM22M_difkur` have identical tracks, and only their `.store` files change.

bugs.title: The atmosphere's gravity is the last point's
bugs.runs: Every atmosphere line writes the last envelope point's gravity (all 113 at 5.950E+02 in `testsuite/Test_m0p3feh+0p0GS98_scv_ZAMS`, model 7); with the fix, that case's track is identical and its `.store` file within 2%.

bugs.title: The atmosphere's luminosity is set only in the envelope branch
bugs.runs: In the 13 runs that wrote the atmosphere's lines, `LSTENV` was on, so `B` was always set; `LSTCH` and `LSTATM` on with `LSTENV` off would reach it.

bugs.title: LPULPT is never set
bugs.runs: In 17 runs `LPULPT` was false every time, as gfortran's zero-filled storage gives, so the results are right with that compiler.

bugs.title: Three routines apply the spots only without a surface convection zone
bugs.runs: Not reached in the spotted 1 M☉ case: STARIN's fitting point needed no move, and WRTMOD is not called with LSTCH, which every spotted YREC case sets; the fix left the outputs identical.

bugs.title: Missing gravities used at the top of a row
bugs.runs: In `testsuite/Test_solarGS98_kurucz` and `testsuite/Test_solarM22M_difkur`, with `atmk1990p00.tab`, no row with missing highest gravities was met; a cool dwarf with a table of [Fe/H] at or below -2.3 would reach it.

bugs.title: ICZTOP is not set for a single zone
bugs.runs: TAUCAL runs only with `LNEWTCZ` off, which no case sets; `LNEWTCZ` = .FALSE., with the base of a single surface convection zone inside the envelope, would reach it.

bugs.title: The overturn time at IMAX is overwritten
bugs.runs: No model in the 33 runs took the branch; a single surface convection zone with few shells near its base would reach it.

bugs.title: The restarts can read past the profile, and can loop forever
bugs.runs: Never occurred: 120 restarts in the 1.4 M☉ diffusion case (IBEG 298 to 352, M 407 to 427), none in four other cases; IBEG never passed M, nor IMAX+2. The fix was not run.

bugs.title: No check of the array sizes
bugs.runs: Both callers pass `NSPEC` = 4.

bugs.title: Spots can stop the run on a point that is convective without them
bugs.runs: In `testsuite/Test_m0p1feh+0p0GS98_spot25_ZAMS`, the spot correction ran 1,418,129 times and `DELDEL` stayed at 0.0788 or more; a spotted point near a zone's edge where the correction makes `DELDEL` vanish would reach it.

bugs.title: With spots, the derivatives of the gradient are those of the unspotted one
bugs.runs: In the spotted 1 M☉ case the derivatives were taken 974,865 times with S = 0.878 to 0.99982; the fix moves log L by up to 0.00055 dex, against 0.000051 for a null change.

bugs.title: The interpolation does not move with the midpoint
bugs.runs: In `testsuite/Test_m0p8feh+0p0GS98_rotp8p0d0p1mag1e4std_TAMS`, the fix moves central X by 1.7e-4 at one model, against at most 6.1e-5 for the null change, and log L by 0.00018 dex, against 0.00019.

bugs.title: The $\mu$ factor compounds on FESTIME
bugs.runs: `FESTIME` is read only in the `LDIFAD` branch, and PARMIN stops any run that sets `LDIFAD` with rotation.

bugs.title: CC is never set
bugs.runs: In `testsuite/Test_m2p0_feh+0p0_vzams150_IES2_TAMS`, the fix moves log L by up to 0.0056 dex and central log T by 0.0055, against about 2e-8 for the null change, with the same 546 models.

bugs.title: FES for the GSF velocity
bugs.runs: In `testsuite/Test_m2p0_feh+0p0_vzams150_IES2_TAMS`, the fallback ran with `VGSF` = 0 every time, and `FES` = `FGSF` in every namelist; `IMU` = 3 with `FES` and `FGSF` different and a positive GSF velocity would reach it.

bugs.title: IES = 2 with LDIFAD reuses the previous call's parts
bugs.runs: PARMIN stops any run that sets `LDIFAD` with rotation.

bugs.title: ELECN is not the electron density
bugs.runs: In `testsuite/Test_3Msolar_GS_rot_gray_OPALSCV_SF2_GS98_OP_CF10_RGp2diffrotI3cz2`, the fix moves log L by up to 0.0022 dex, against 0.0076 for the null change; the other rotating cases were not run with it.

bugs.title: The total $Z$ counts as an ion
bugs.runs: In the rotating solar model species 3 entered COMSUM at 1,789,275 shells; the fix's effect is about the size of the null change, not clearly beyond it (log L 0.00021 against 0.00029 dex, surface rotation 0.0089 against 0.0068 km/s).

bugs.title: Three isotope masses are mistyped
bugs.runs: In the rotating solar model the three mistyped masses were used at 1,789,275 shells; the fix's effect is about the size of the null change, not clearly beyond it (surface rotation 0.0095 against 0.0068 km/s, log L 0.00027 against 0.00029 dex).

bugs.title: WNEW overwrites the namelist's solid-body rate
bugs.runs: Every rotating case uses the new law, so WIND never ran; `LROT` with `LMWIND` off, and a later run that reads its model from file with `LWNEW`, would reach it.

bugs.title: The headers of track versions 1, 2, and 3 do not match the data
bugs.runs: Every case sets `ITRVER` = 0; the default `ITRVER` = 1, which a namelist without the line gets, or 2 or 3, would reach it.

bugs.title: A lost label
bugs.runs: The SCV branch ran at every model in 32 runs, but never with `LOPALE06` on and `LDH` off; YREC's cases use SCV only with `LDH`.

bugs.title: Unset atmosphere label
bugs.runs: In 33 runs `KTTAU` was never outside 0 to 5; only an invalid `KTTAU`, which nothing in YREC offers, would reach it.

bugs.title: The file is closed after each model
bugs.runs: `LMILNE` is off by default and set in no case; `LMILNE` on, with two or more models written, would reach it.

bugs.title: A typo in $d\rho/dr$
bugs.runs: In seven solar cases with `LPULSE`, such as `testsuite/Test_solarGS98_dif`, `QPR1` differed from `QPR2` by -5.6% to +10.3% on every shell; with the fix, `testsuite/Test_solarGS98_allard` and `testsuite/Test_solarM22M_difkur` have identical tracks and `.store` files.

bugs.title: The pulsation model's shell list is never set
bugs.runs: In all nine runs with `LPULSE`, such as `testsuite/Test_solarGS98_dif`, `IDM` was 0 every time, so the pulsation model was written with 0 shells; no fix was run.

bugs.title: Debugging prints
bugs.runs: The prints ran at every call in 10 runs; with them removed, `testsuite/Test_solarAAG21_dif` and `testsuite/Test_solarGS98_allard` have identical tracks and `.store` files.

bugs.title: LPRT may be unset
bugs.runs: In 10 runs the line always ran with `LSTORE` on, so `LPRT` was set; `LPULSE` with `LSTORE` off would reach it.

bugs.title: Track version 2 without rotation writes rotation values never set
bugs.runs: Every case sets `ITRVER` = 0; `ITRVER` = 2 without `LROT` would reach it.

bugs.title: The summary gives the neutrino fluxes and capture rates in erg
bugs.runs: With the labels corrected, `testsuite/Test_m0p3feh+0p0GS98_scv_ZAMS` and `testsuite/Test_3Msolar_GS_rot_gray_OPALSCV_SF2_GS98_OP_CF10_RGp2diffrotI3cz2` have identical tracks; only their `.short` files differ.

bugs.title: 0/0 where $\Omega$ is zero
bugs.runs: In all five rotating runs, the central rotation rate was never zero; a rotating run with no rotation at the center would reach it.
